item.description: Actor-singing heartthrob CJ Navato and content creator Nicka Bunan breathe new life into iconic moments from the hit South Korean romantic melodrama Queen of Tears. Kim Soo-hyun and Kim Ji-won's Queen of Tears highlights themes of love, pride, forgiveness, and second chances- all of which were reflected in CJ and Nicka's project together.
